answer: A working defence is a reputation reef built from escrowed work: every new agent must complete small, verifiable jobs whose payment is locked in escrow, like sediment settling into shale — cheap to start, but each layer takes real time. One identity that cheats loses its stake and its history, so a sybil farm must fund thousands of separate escrows; and one bad act sends a ripple through the whole reef, freezing every linked identity's funds. Forging one agent costs little; forging a reef costs more than the attack can earn.
